header.title: Outreach
header.postingStoppedAlert: All public posting is stopped: outreach and Connections publish nothing until you resume. Approved outreach drafts stay approved; queued Connections publishes wait on the Approvals page.
header.howItWorks: Scout/draft runs queue comments here and nothing posts until you approve it. Approved Reddit, YouTube and Facebook drafts post one at a time from the Approvals page, with Post now, while you watch the Agent Screen; the Discord bot sends Discord drafts.

profile.title: What you promote
profile.noSiteUrl: No site URL: self-share and linked comments are skipped until one is set.
profile.empty: Nothing to promote yet. Drafts, self-share and snippets stay empty until you add a name and a pitch.

queue.title: Queue ({{count}})
queue.newTooltip: Start a new draft from scratch
queue.redditPassTooltip: Add a Reddit outreach pass to the Job Queue (next sub from targets.json) — drafts land here when it's done
queue.youtubePassTooltip: Scout YouTube for videos matching your profile's feature keywords, then draft comments with your repo link into this queue
queue.selfShareTooltip: Add a self-share pass to the Job Queue — submits a link post to the next round-robin sub
queue.passTopicsHelp: Comma-separated. Used by YouTube keyword scout and Reddit thread filter.
queue.youtubePassNote: YouTube pass scouts your profile's feature keywords then drafts comments with your repo link for your approval.
queue.approvedNote: Start Reddit, YouTube and Facebook posts from the <approvalsLink>Approvals page</approvalsLink> with Post now; the Discord bot sends Discord drafts.
queue.empty: No drafts pending. Add an Outreach pass to the Job Queue, or wait for the scheduled ticks, then refresh to see new entries.

source.title: Source
source.empty: Select a queue item to load its source context.

snippets.title: Snippet bank
snippets.fillProfile: Fill in "What you promote" to get snippets here.

drafting.redraftTooltip: Have the LLM redraft this with current tone + platform
drafting.placeholder: Pick a queue item to load its draft, or type one here. Markdown is fine for Reddit / Discord.

citation.title: Citation tool
citation.placeholder: Paste a URL — title + domain pulled for clean attribution

action.title: Action
action.fixWarnings: Fix pre-flight warnings (length / grade / empty draft) before approving.
action.note: Approve posts nothing. An approved Reddit, YouTube or Facebook draft is posted from the Approvals page with Post now while you watch the Agent Screen; the Discord bot sends Discord drafts. Reject removes it from the queue.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing in this view yet. Drafts that get approved and successfully post will appear under 'posted'; servo failures land under 'aborted'; ones you reject in the queue land under 'rejected'; approved drafts that nothing here can post on their platform (a reply outside YouTube, for one) land under 'unsupported'.

newDraft.title: New outreach draft
newDraft.subtitle: Lands in the queue as a drafted row. Approve later from the main panel — or seed the body with the LLM, edit, and save.
newDraft.scoutTooltip: Have the agent fetch OP + top comments for this URL
newDraft.threadIdPlaceholder: auto-filled by Scout for Reddit URLs
newDraft.notShipped: Nothing here posts to {{platform}}; approving keeps the row but does not ship it.
newDraft.toneNote: Tone for LLM seeding picks up the main page's tone selector ({{tone}}).
newDraft.seeded: Seeded queue row #{{id}} — Save will update it in place.
newDraft.contextPlaceholder: Paste the OP + a few top comments, or describe what the thread is about. The LLM uses this to draft a relevant reply.
newDraft.draftTooltip: Have the LLM draft the body from the topic + tone above
newDraft.bodyPlaceholder: Type the post here, or click 'Draft with LLM' to seed it from the topic above.

profileDialog.title: What you promote
profileDialog.subtitle: Stays on this machine (data/social_outreach/profile.json). Drafts cite only what is here; the pitch sheet in data/agent/PITCH.md, when present, takes precedence over the pitch and features.
profileDialog.name: Name
profileDialog.handlePlaceholder: the account you post from, without @
profileDialog.pitchPlaceholder: One or two sentences on what it is and who it is for.
profileDialog.siteUrlHelp: Where comments and self-share posts point. Links to it get UTM tags.
profileDialog.repoUrlHelp: Preferred over the site on YouTube.
profileDialog.videosEmpty: Each one becomes an insert button in the snippet bank.
profileDialog.label: Label
profileDialog.featuresNote: The blurb is what a draft may say about the feature. Keywords (comma-separated, whole words) are what a thread has to mention for the scouts to pick it up; the first feature whose keyword matches wins, so list the specific ones first.

postingDialog.resumeBody: Posts can go out again. Held Connections publishes stay on the Approvals page until someone approves them; approved outreach drafts can be posted again while outreach is enabled (Reddit, YouTube and Facebook with Post now on the Approvals page).
postingDialog.stopBody: Nothing is posted publicly from this install until you resume: no outreach replies or shares, and no Connections publishes, including scheduled, chat and MCP requests. Queued Connections publishes are held on the Approvals page and need approving again; approved outreach drafts stay approved. A post already being sent may still go out. This is separate from the outreach Enabled switch.

enableDialog.disableBody: This turns the kill switch off: scheduled ticks and new passes stop. Approved drafts will not post until you enable again.
enableDialog.enableBody: This turns outreach on. Every draft still waits for your approval, and Reddit, YouTube and Facebook posts start only from Post now on the Approvals page.
